# contaix

> Tools to make contexts for AI


## Pages in this subsection

- [contaix](contaix.html.md): Tools to make contexts (knowledge bases for AI agents)
- [contaix.aggregation](contaix.aggregation.html.md): Tools for aggregating contexts
- [contaix.code](contaix.code.html.md): Tools to make AI contexts from code bases
- [contaix.markdown](contaix.markdown.html.md): Converting things to markdown
- [contaix.skills](contaix.skills.html.md): Skill discovery and installation for the contaix ecosystem.
- [contaix.urls](contaix.urls.html.md): Work with urls
- [contaix.util](contaix.util.html.md): General utilities for contaix
- [contaix.web](contaix.web.html.md): Web content extraction and aggregation tools.
